general.q: What areas does Clear Day Bath Solutions cover for remodeling projects?
general.a: We serve Northern Virginia, Maryland and the greater DC metro from our base in Woodbridge, VA. That includes Prince William, Fairfax, Stafford, Fauquier, Loudoun and King George counties in Virginia, and Frederick, Washington, Howard, Anne Arundel, Montgomery, Prince George's and Charles counties in Maryland. If you are not sure whether you are inside our radius, call us and we will tell you straight away rather than sending someone on a wasted trip.

general.q: How does a tub-to-shower conversion benefit my home's value and safety?
general.a: Stepping over a 15-inch tub wall is the single most common way people get hurt in a bathroom. Replacing that tub with a low-threshold or barrier-free shower removes the obstacle entirely, and adding grab bars and a seat makes the space usable for decades rather than years. On the resale side, a dated tub in a hall bath reads as deferred maintenance to buyers, while a clean modern shower reads as a bathroom they will not have to touch.

general.q: What exactly is included in your custom wet-area remodeling?
general.a: The wet area is everything water touches: the tub or shower base, the surround walls, the valve and fixtures, the door or curtain rod, and the waterproofing behind all of it. A custom job means the base and surround are sized to your actual opening rather than forcing a stock unit into a space it does not fit. We handle demolition, disposal, installation and cleanup, and we leave the room usable when we go.

general.q: What are your hours, and how do I schedule a consultation?
general.a: We are reachable Monday through Friday 8am to 8pm, and Saturday and Sunday 9am to 4pm. Call 571-751-7598 or send the quote form on any page. A consultation is an in-home visit where we measure the space, look at the existing plumbing and give you a written price. There is no charge and no obligation to book work.

general.q: What makes Clear Day different from the larger bath franchises?
general.a: We are locally owned and we work in the same counties we live in, so the person who quotes your job is accountable for how it turns out. Franchise operations often route you through a call centre and a commissioned closer working from a fixed price book. We quote what your bathroom actually needs, we will tell you when a smaller scope will do, and you can reach us directly afterwards.
